content.text: Hello English learners and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco. I'm Amira. And Amira and I are here today with a great, great lesson for you.
content.trans: 你好，英语学习者和欢迎来到英语频道。我的名字叫马克，我叫安里亚。今天我和你们在这里分享一个非常重要的主题。

content.text: Yes, we are. Today we're going to be talking about a restaurant. Amira, why don't you give us a little bit more details?
content.trans: 是的，我们是。今天我们将谈论一家餐厅。阿米拉，你愿意给我们一些更多的细节吗？

content.text: Well, we're talking about a situation in a restaurant and two people are involved, the waiter and the customer. And I don't want to say anymore.
content.trans: 嗯，我们是在一家餐厅里讨论的情况。服务员和顾客两个人都参与进来，我就不想再说了。

content.text: Okay, don't say anymore. Let's just listen to this dialogue and we'll be back later to explain it.
content.trans: 好的，不用说了。我们先听这段对话，然后我们会回到这里来解释它。

content.text: Good evening. My name is Fabio. I'll be your waiter for tonight. May I take your order?
content.trans: 晚上好。我的名字是Fabio，我今晚将是你的服务员。请问，请给我点餐吧？

content.text: No, I'm still working on it. This menu is not even in English. What's good here?
content.trans: 英语：不，我现在还在努力。菜单在这里不是中文。这里有什么好？

content.text: For you, sir, I would recommend spaghetti and meatballs. Does it come with coconut fries?
content.trans: 英语：对于您，先生，我建议你吃意大利面和肉丸。它是否带椰菜呢？

content.text: It comes with either soup or salad and a complimentary glass of wine, sir.
content.trans: 英文：它附带汤或沙拉，还赠送一瓶红酒，请问先生。

content.text: I'll go with the spaghetti and meatballs, salad and the wine. Excellent choice. Your order will be ready soon.
content.trans: 我将跟您一起享用意大利面、肉酱和红酒。这道菜非常美味，您的订单很快就会准备好。

content.text: How soon is soon? 20 minutes? You know what? I'll just go grab a burger across the street.
content.trans: 英语：如何快点？20分钟？你知道吗？我直接去拿个汉堡在对面走。

content.text: Oh, what a waiter. What a waiter. He is really angry at this customer and I can't blame him. I would be angry too.
content.trans: 啊，真是个服务员。真是个服务员。他真的很生气，而且这个顾客我也不好说。我也很气愤。

content.text: Yeah, so I think, Marco, you have chosen some interesting expressions for us here. What is the first one?
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。我同意，Marco先生，您在这里选择了一些有趣表达。请问第一个是什么？

content.text: Well, the first one is I'm still working on it. I'm still working on it. I'm still working on it. I'm still working on it.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，第一件是我还还在努力中。我还在努力中。我还在努力中。我还在努力中。

content.text: Why don't we listen to some other examples on how you can use this word and then we'll come back and explain it.
content.trans: 英语：为什么我们不先看看你如何使用这个单词，然后再解释一下呢？

content.text: Did you finish reading the magazine? I'm still working on it.
content.trans: 是吗？我还还在做呢。

content.text: Did you fix my car? I'm still working on it.
content.trans: 英语：你帮我修理车了吗？我还在修车上呢。

content.text: So you could say I'm still working on it. Means I still need more time.
content.trans: 所以你可以说我现在还在努力。这意味着我还需要更多的时间。

content.text: Fantastic. Great. Okay, it's clear.
content.trans: 很好。行，清楚了。

content.text: I have another one for you guys. It's a phrase commonly used and you'll hear it all the time.
content.trans: 我还有其他一个，你 guys 可以经常听到。

content.text: Coke and fries. Coke and fries. Coke and fries. It's a short way of saying Coca-Cola and French fries.
content.trans: 英语：可乐和薯条。可乐和薯条。可乐和薯条。这是一种短语，表示可乐和法国炸薯条。

content.text: So that's basically America's fast food. Yeah, burger, coke and fries. Okay. What's next on the menu?
content.trans: 所以，基本上美国的快餐业是这么样的。对了，汉堡、可乐和薯条。好的，接下来该怎么做？

content.text: On the menu we have a complimentary glass of wine. Complementary glass of wine. Complementary glass of wine.
content.trans: 菜单上我们有免费的玻璃酒。免费的玻璃酒。

content.text: Complementary means that it's free. Free. Yes. We love that. Yeah, we definitely like free things.
content.trans: 互补意味着它免费。免费。我们爱这个。是的，我们绝对喜欢免费的东西。

content.text: Well, I have another one for us here. Another interesting phrase. I'll go with. I'll go with. I'll go with.
content.trans: 好的，我有另外一句可以和大家一起分享。接下来我会选择。

content.text: So basically it's another way of saying I'm choosing. Yeah, I'll choose or I'll take. I'll take. Okay, very good.
content.trans: 所以基本上它又是一种表达方式。嗯，我选择或者我会接受。我会接受。很好，非常棒。

content.text: Alright, the next word that I want to take a look at is grab. Grab. Grab. Grab. Grab.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我下一个需要翻译的单词。

content.text: Okay, now let's listen to some other examples of how we could use grab in different situations and then we'll come back and explain it.
content.trans: 好的，现在让我们来听一些其他例子，如何用grab在不同的情境中使用，并且我们将在回来时再解释一下。

content.text: On your way home, can you grab some milk?
content.trans: 英语：在路上，你能把奶瓶放下来吗？

content.text: Wait for me, please. I need to grab my coat.
content.trans: 请等我一下，好吗？我需要把我的外套拿好。

content.text: Let's grab a cup of coffee.
content.trans: 让我们来杯咖啡。

content.text: Alright, well, I would understand that go grab means go get quickly. To go get quickly, yeah.
content.trans: 好的，好吧。我理解“go grab”意味着快速地去拿。快速地去拿，对吗？

content.text: Alright, everyone. So now it's time to listen one more time to the dialogue and listen carefully and try to understand why the waiter doesn't like the customer. Let's listen.
content.trans: 好的，我已经准备好。请继续。

content.text: Good evening. My name is Fabio. I'll be your waiter for tonight. May I take your order?
content.trans: 晚上好。我的名字是Fabio，我今晚将是你的服务员。请问，请给我点餐。

content.text: No, I'm still working on it. This menu is not even in English. What's good here? For you, sir, I would recommend spaghetti and meatballs.
content.trans: 英语：我不太确定，我还在努力。菜单上连英文都不懂，这里有什么好推荐？对了，你要是有空的话，可以试试意大利面和肉酱面。

content.text: Does it come with coconut fries? It comes with either soup or salad and a complimentary glass of wine, sir.
content.trans: 是吗？它带什么？有沙拉或沙司，还有红酒，请享用。

content.text: I'll go with the spaghetti and meatballs, salad and the wine. Excellent choice. Your order will be ready soon. How soon is soon?
content.trans: 我将跟您一起享用意大利面、肉酱面和红酒。这个选择非常棒，您的订单很快就会准备好。马上就可以收到吗？

content.text: 20 minutes? You know what? I'll just go grab a burger across the street.
content.trans: 20分钟？你懂的吗？我直接去拿个汉堡车过街。

content.text: Marco, why did this waiter get angry at the customer?
content.trans: 英语：Marco，为什么这个服务员对顾客这么生气？

content.text: Well, he basically wasted the waiter's time. I mean, this guy comes into the restaurant. He is not very polite and he's asking all these questions. In the end, he just gets up and says, I'll just go grab a burger across the street.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，他基本上浪费了服务员的时间。我指的是这个家伙进入餐厅。他不很礼貌，而且问了很多问题。最后，他站起来说：“我会去拿个汉堡到对面的街上去。”

content.text: I also think that this guy was a lot more casual than the place he was in, right? Yeah, I think this was a nice fancy restaurant. I think he was in the wrong place.
content.trans: 我也是觉得这个家伙比他所在的地点要随意得多，对吧？是的，我觉得这是一家漂亮的高档餐厅。我认为他在错的地方。

content.text: How many times, Marco, tell me, do you really have fast food a week?
content.trans: 英语：你真快，Marco？

content.text: Fast food. Let's see Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. Oh, my God. No, no. I think I get fast food maybe once a week, once or twice a week.
content.trans: 英语：快餐。让我们看看周一、周二和周三吧。哦，我的天啊！不，不，我猜我可能每周都吃快餐，或者偶尔吃两次。

content.text: All right, talking about fast food made me hungry, so I think I'm going to go grab something to eat myself. Yeah, me too.
content.trans: 好的，谈到了快餐让我饿了，所以我决定自己去吃点东西。嗯，我也一样。

content.text: All right. I hope you guys enjoyed the lesson today and remember that all of this vocabulary is useful for your everyday needs.
content.trans: 好的。我希望大家今天的学习愉快，记住这些词汇对你们的日常生活非常有用。

content.text: Yes. Well, actually here in English pod, we focus on phrases and words that are high frequency and that means that you can use them every day in your practical life.
content.trans: 是的。嗯，实际上在英语小课堂上，我们特别强调高频词汇和常用短语，这样你可以在日常生活中使用它们。

content.text: Exactly. And be sure to go to our website at EnglishPod.com where you can find many other resources and you can leave your questions and comments at our community forum.
content.trans: 英语：它就是傻瓜相机。

content.text: So thank you very much for listening. We'll be back tomorrow is another great lesson for you. So until then, bye.
content.trans: 英语：所以感谢你倾听。我们明天还会给你带来一个很好的学习机会。直到那时，再见！
